properties.name: spring.data.jdbc.format-sql
properties.description: Whether the SQL in the log is on several lines.

properties.name: spring.data.jdbc.rate-limit.create-table
properties.description: Whether the store creates the table when it is not there. Default: only when `spring.data.jdbc.schema` is `create` or `create-drop`; else the table comes from a migration (the SQL is in the package: `sql/rate_limit/postgresql.sql`, `sql/rate_limit/sqlite.sql`).

properties.name: spring.data.jdbc.rate-limit.table
properties.description: The table of the buckets: a name, or `schema.name`.

properties.name: spring.data.jdbc.schema
properties.description: What the starter does with the schema: `none`, `validate` (tables and columns of the entities must exist and fit), `create`, `create-drop` (from the entities; not with migrations or scripts).

properties.name: spring.data.jdbc.show-parameters
properties.description: Whether the bound values are logged at info too, instead of trace; those of secret-looking names stay masked.

properties.name: spring.data.jdbc.show-sql
properties.description: Whether the statements are logged at info, so they show with the default level (Spring Boot's `spring.jpa.show-sql`).

properties.name: spring.data.jdbc.slow-query-threshold
properties.description: A slower statement is logged at warn. Default: none.

properties.name: spring.data.memory.lock-timeout
properties.description: The in-memory store's wait for a row lock, such as `500ms` or `10s`; zero fails at once, as `nowait` does. Default: 10s.

properties.name: spring.data.store
properties.description: The store of the repositories without `@UseStore` and `@UseDataSource`: `memory`, `jdbc`, or the name of another store (`DataStore.name`). Default: `jdbc` with a primary data source, else `memory`.

properties.name: spring.data.web.pageable.default-page-size
properties.description: The page size when the request has no `size`.

properties.name: spring.data.web.pageable.max-page-size
properties.description: The largest page size; a larger `size` is cut to it.

properties.name: spring.data.web.pageable.one-indexed-parameters
properties.description: Whether the `page` parameter starts at 1 instead of 0.

properties.name: spring.data.web.pageable.page-parameter
properties.description: The name of the page number parameter.

properties.name: spring.data.web.pageable.prefix
properties.description: A prefix put before the page and size parameter names.

properties.name: spring.data.web.pageable.qualifier-delimiter
properties.description: The delimiter between a `@Qualifier` and the parameter name (`x_page`).

properties.name: spring.data.web.pageable.size-parameter
properties.description: The name of the page size parameter.

properties.name: spring.data.web.sort.sort-parameter
properties.description: The name of the sort parameter.

properties.name: spring.datasource.driver
properties.description: The driver's name (`sqlite3`, `postgres`), when two drivers handle the scheme.

properties.name: spring.datasource.password
properties.description: The database password.

properties.name: spring.datasource.pool.connection-timeout
properties.description: The longest wait for a connection, then `CannotGetJdbcConnectionException`. Default: 30s.

properties.name: spring.datasource.pool.idle-timeout
properties.description: An idle connection above `min-idle` older than this is closed; zero keeps them forever. Default: 10m.

properties.name: spring.datasource.pool.max-lifetime
properties.description: A connection older than this is closed when it comes back to the pool; zero: no limit. Default: 30m.

properties.name: spring.datasource.pool.max-size
properties.description: Most connections at once, at least 1.

properties.name: spring.datasource.pool.min-idle
properties.description: Connections kept open when idle, from 0 to `max-size` (Hikari keeps as many as `max-size`).

properties.name: spring.datasource.pool.validation
properties.description: Whether a connection that waited in the pool is checked with `isValid` before it is handed out.

properties.name: spring.datasource.postgresql.application-name
properties.description: Shown in `pg_stat_activity`.

properties.name: spring.datasource.postgresql.connect-timeout
properties.description: The longest wait for the connection and the TLS handshake (`500ms`, `30s`, `1m`, or milliseconds; this key does not take `PT30S`). Default: 15s.

properties.name: spring.datasource.postgresql.search-path
properties.description: The schemas of `search_path`, comma separated (the URL's `currentSchema`). Default: the server's.

properties.name: spring.datasource.postgresql.ssl-root-cert
properties.description: PEM file of the certificate authorities a `verify-*` mode checks the server against. Default: system roots.

properties.name: spring.datasource.postgresql.sslmode
properties.description: Whether and how the connection uses TLS (libpq's `sslmode`).

properties.name: spring.datasource.sqlite.base-directory
properties.description: Where relative `sqlite:file:` names are looked for; in a Flutter app the starter sets it (SQLite databases). Default: working directory.

properties.name: spring.datasource.sqlite.busy-timeout
properties.description: Milliseconds a connection waits for SQLite's lock.

properties.name: spring.datasource.sqlite.isolate
properties.description: `true` opens each connection inside an isolate of its own, so a long query or a busy wait does not hold the caller's isolate (the UI's, the web server's); in a Flutter app the starter sets it to `true`.

properties.name: spring.datasource.url
properties.description: The database URL: `sqlite:file:books.db`, `sqlite::memory:` or `postgresql://user:password@host/db`; the scheme chooses the driver.

properties.name: spring.datasource.username
properties.description: The database user.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.data.jdbc.schema
properties.description: What the starter does with the schema of this data source: `none`, `validate` (tables and columns of the entities must exist and fit), `create`, `create-drop` (from the entities; not with migrations or scripts).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.driver
properties.description: The driver's name (`sqlite3`, `postgres`), when two drivers handle the scheme.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.password
properties.description: The database password.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.pool.connection-timeout
properties.description: The longest wait for a connection, then `CannotGetJdbcConnectionException`. Default: 30s.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.pool.idle-timeout
properties.description: An idle connection above `min-idle` older than this is closed; zero keeps them forever. Default: 10m.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.pool.max-lifetime
properties.description: A connection older than this is closed when it comes back to the pool; zero: no limit. Default: 30m.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.pool.max-size
properties.description: Most connections at once, at least 1.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.pool.min-idle
properties.description: Connections kept open when idle, from 0 to `max-size` (Hikari keeps as many as `max-size`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.pool.validation
properties.description: Whether a connection that waited in the pool is checked with `isValid` before it is handed out.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.postgresql.application-name
properties.description: Shown in `pg_stat_activity`.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.postgresql.connect-timeout
properties.description: The longest wait for the connection and the TLS handshake (`500ms`, `30s`, `1m`, or milliseconds; this key does not take `PT30S`). Default: 15s.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.postgresql.search-path
properties.description: The schemas of `search_path`, comma separated (the URL's `currentSchema`). Default: the server's.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.postgresql.ssl-root-cert
properties.description: PEM file of the certificate authorities a `verify-*` mode checks the server against. Default: system roots.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.postgresql.sslmode
properties.description: Whether and how the connection uses TLS (libpq's `sslmode`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.init.continue-on-error
properties.description: Whether a failed statement is logged and skipped instead of stopping the start (`continue-on-error`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.init.data-locations
properties.description: The locations of the data scripts (`data-locations`); empty for the default, `resources:data.sql` and `resources:data-PLATFORM.sql`.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.init.encoding
properties.description: The encoding of the script files (`encoding`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.init.mode
properties.description: When `schema.sql` / `data.sql` run: `embedded` (in-memory databases only), `always`, `never`.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.init.platform
properties.description: The platform in the names of the platform scripts (`platform`); `all` by default.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.init.schema-locations
properties.description: The locations of the schema scripts (`schema-locations`); empty for the default, `resources:schema.sql` and `resources:schema-PLATFORM. sql`, both optional. A location you give must exist, unless it starts with `optional:`; `@@platform@@` in it is replaced by the platform.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.init.separator
properties.description: The separator of the statements (`separator`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.baseline-description
properties.description: The description of the baseline (`baseline-description`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.baseline-on-migrate
properties.description: Whether a database with tables and no history is taken as being at the [baselineVersion] instead of stopping the start (`baseline-on-migrate`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.baseline-version
properties.description: The version of the baseline (`baseline-version`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.connect-retries
properties.description: How many times a failed connection to the database is retried at startup (`connect-retries`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.connect-retries-interval
properties.description: How long to wait between two of those attempts (`connect-retries-interval`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.enabled
properties.description: Whether migrations run: `lib/resources/db/migration/V<version>__<name>.sql` and `R__<name>.sql`; with no files nothing runs anyway (`enabled`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.group
properties.description: Whether all the pending migrations run in one transaction instead of each in its own (`group`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.ignore-migration-patterns
properties.description: Which problems of the history are ignored (`ignore-migration- patterns`): `type:status` with the type `versioned`, `repeatable` or `*` and the status `missing` (applied, not in the files, below the latest file), `future` (applied, newer than every file), `ignored` (a file below the latest applied, never applied) or `*`. The default `*:future` lets a database from a later version of the application start.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.locations
properties.description: Where the files are (`locations`); `{vendor}` is replaced by the dialect's name (`sqlite`, `postgresql`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.lock-timeout
properties.description: How long the runner waits for the migration lock another process holds before it gives up (`lock-timeout`, one minute).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.out-of-order
properties.description: Whether a file with a version below the latest applied one still runs (`out-of-order`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.placeholder-prefix
properties.description: What a placeholder starts with (`placeholder-prefix`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.placeholder-replacement
properties.description: Whether the scripts have their placeholders replaced (`placeholder-replacement`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.placeholder-suffix
properties.description: What a placeholder ends with (`placeholder-suffix`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.placeholders.*
properties.description: The values of the placeholders of the scripts (`placeholders.<name>`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.table
properties.description: The history table (`table`).

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.target
properties.description: The version to migrate to, or `latest` (`target`). Repeatable migrations run only for `latest`.

properties.name: spring.datasources.*.sql.migration.validate-on-migrate
properties.description: Whether an applied migration whose checksum changed, or that is missing from the files, or a file older than the applied ones that was never applied, stops the start (`validate-on-migrate`).
